theme.aria: Whakawhiti i waenga i te āhua mārama me te āhua pōuri
index.title: AI-gile: tō rōpū hanga AI i runga i te papa kotahi
index.description: He papa kanban a AI-gile mō ngā rōpū waehere AI. Ka mahi rātou i a koe e moe ana; ka toe māu he puranga poto: he mea hei whakatau, hei whakamātau, hei whakaae.
hero.h1.html: Tō rōpū hanga AI, i runga i te papa kotahi.
hero.alphaTitle: Tōmua, kāore anō kia oti: ngā mihi mō tō whakamātau!
hero.lede: Ka hanga rātou i a koe e moe ana. Ka ara koe ki te puranga poto kotahi: ētahi pātai, ētahi mea hei whakamātau, tētahi taimana waiporoporo e rua rānei. Pāwhiri, whakaae, hoki ki tō kawhe.
hero.secondary: Agile, engari kāore te rōpū e hiahia ana ki te kawhe tū. (Heoi ka mahi tonu rātou i ngā stand-up.)
pitch.h2: AI-gile i te maha o ngā kupu e hiahia ana koe
pitch.lede: Kōwhiria te roa, mai i te kupu kotahi ki te 144. He whakaahuatanga motuhake ia roa, i tuhia mō taua rahi. Toia te kaiwhakahaere, whakamahia rānei ngā pātuhi pere.
count.line.html.other: E {n} ngā kāri kei te papa i tēnei wā
count.line.html.one: E {n} ngā kāri kei te papa i tēnei wā
f.pile.html: Māu kei konei ngā mea katoa e tatari ana ki a koe, puta noa i ngā kaupapa katoa: ngā pātai, ngā mea hei whakamātau, ngā mahi mā te tangata anake. Ka mea tō rārangi he aha te mea e whai ake nei, me te roa e pau ai.
f.sleep.h: Ngā rōpū e mahi ana i a koe e moe ana
f.sleep.p: He kaihautū me tētahi rōpū kaiwhakahaere AI tō ia kaupapa. Tāpiritia he kōrero ki tētahi kāri, ka oho te rōpū, ka mahi, ka hoatu anō me ngā hikoi e ngāwari ana mā te tangata ngenge.
f.tester.h: Ka tirotiro tuatahi he kaiwhakamātau AI
f.tester.p: I mua i te taenga ki a koe, ka whai te kaiwhakamātau i ngā hikoi i runga i tētahi kape o te taupānga, ka whakaatu i tāna i kite ai, me te tānga mata. Tirohia wawe ngā mea i ngata, ka whakaae mā te pāwhiri kotahi.
f.proof.h: He taunakitanga, ehara i te oati
f.proof.p: Ka whakaatu ia tuku i ngā mea kua rerekē: ngā kōnae, te rerekētanga, ngā tānga mata. Kāore e tika kia whakatuwheratia ia taupānga hei tiro mēnā kua oti.
f.chat.p: He kōrero-ara pērā i a Discord: kotahi te tohu mō ia kaupapa, he taimana waiporoporo mō ngā mea e hiahia ana ki a koe. Tukuna he whakaaro ki tētahi kaihautū; ka huri ia hei kāri me tētahi mahere, me tētahi pātene ✅ Haere.
f.tidy.h: Ka noho ia i te tōtika
f.tidy.p: Ka whakakotahi ngā kāri e hāngai ana, ka whakatikahia ngā taitara rangirua, ā, ka tiaki te tirotiro tohu i te waehere kia kōmaki. Torutoru ake ngā mea hei huri atu ki, torutoru ake ngā mea hei whakaaro.
f.private.h: Nōu, i runga i tō rorohiko
f.private.li1: Ka rere te papa i runga i tō ake rorohiko, ā, ko koe anake tāna e whakautu ai.
f.private.li2: He hunahuna ngā karere tūmataiti i waenga i ngā tāngata, mai i tētahi pito ki tētahi.
f.private.li3: Kāore he kāute, kāore he kaiwhai, kāore he pihikete.
f.lang.p: Neke atu i te 120 ngā reo, mai i te Tati, te Wēra me te Hapani ki te kaipahua, ki a Yoda me te Klingon, me tētahi whakawhiti tere ki te reo Ingarihi mō ngā kupu a te kaiwhakawhanake.
tl.aria: Rārangi wā mai i te kōrero tuatahi ki te mahere
tl.h2: Mai i te kōrero tuatahi ki te mea e haere ake nei
tl.lede: He rā me ngā wā tūturu, i tō ake rohe wā. Whai muri i tēnei rā he mahere, kāore he rā i oatitia.
join.lede: Kei te hangaia a AI-gile e tētahi tangata iti me te tini o ngā kaiwhakahaere manawanui. He tūmataiti i tēnei wā, i te alpha kati me ngā hoa. Kei te hiahia koe ki te whakamātau ina tuwhera?
join.small: Ka īmēra atu mātou, kāore atu
footer.tag: AI-gile. Kāore he kaiwhai, kāore he pihikete, kāore he kawhe tū.
form.failed: Kāore i whai hua: whakamātauria anō a muri ake nei.
form.offline: Kāore i taea te toro atu ki a AI-gile: whakamātauria anō a muri ake nei.
interest.title: AI-gile: whakamōhiotia mai ina tuwhera te alpha
interest.description: Waihotia tō īmēra kia mōhio koe ina tuwhera te alpha kati, te beta rānei o AI-gile.
interest.lede: Kei te pre-alpha kati a AI-gile. Waihotia tō īmēra, ā, ka tuhi atu mātou kotahi anake, ina whai wāhi koe.
interest.alpha: Alpha kati: tōmua, taratara, he maha ngā panoni
interest.beta: Beta: kua pūmau ake, mō muri
interest.thanks: Ngā mihi! Kei te rārangi koe.
interest.kept: Ko tō īmēra me te whakamātautau i kōwhiria e koe anake e rongoātia ana, mō tēnei rārangi anake. Kāore he pānui, kāore he kaiwhai.
licence.title: AI-gile: raihana pakihi
licence.description: E whakamahi ana i a AI-gile i tō pakihi? Tonoa he raihana pakihi koreutu.
licence.lede: E whakamahi ana i a AI-gile i te mahi? Kōrerotia mai ko wai koe, he aha tāu mahi. Mēnā he painga tāna, he koreutu te raihana.
licence.thanks: Ngā mihi! Ka whakautu atu mātou mā te īmēra.
status.title: Tūnga o AI-gile
status.offline: Kāore e taea te toro ki te ratonga tūnga i tēnei wā (e whakamātau anō ana)
live.caption: Kua huna ia kāri katoa: ka kite koe i te āhua o te mahi, kaua ko ngā kupu.
live.offline: Kei te okioki paku te papa ora. Hoki mai a muri nei.
